operator.description: An operator in a cell; for example, =, >, <, <=, or <>.

values.description: The values that appear in the cell.

index.description: The index of the icon in the given set.

set.description: The set that the icon is part of. The possible values are: Invalid, ThreeArrows, ThreeArrowsGray, ThreeFlags, ThreeTrafficLights1, ThreeTrafficLights2, ThreeSigns, ThreeSymbols, ThreeSymbols2, FourArrows, FourArrowsGray, FourRedToBlack, FourRating, FourTrafficLights, FiveArrows, FiveArrowsGray, FiveRating, FiveQuarters, ThreeStars, ThreeTriangles, FiveBoxes.

driveId.description: Unique identifier of the drive instance that contains the driveItem. Only returned if the item is located in a drive. Read-only.

driveType.description: Identifies the type of drive. Only returned if the item is located in a drive. See drive resource for values.

id.description: Unique identifier of the driveItem in the drive or a listItem in a list. Read-only.

name.description: The name of the item being referenced. Read-only.

path.description: Percent-encoded path that can be used to navigate to the item. Read-only.

shareId.description: A unique identifier for a shared resource that can be accessed via the Shares API.

sharepointIds.description: Returns identifiers useful for SharePoint REST compatibility. Read-only.

siteId.description: For OneDrive for Business and SharePoint, this property represents the ID of the site that contains the parent document library of the driveItem resource or the parent list of the listItem resource. The value is the same as the id property of that site resource. It is an opaque string that consists of three identifiers of the site. For OneDrive, this property is not populated.

displayName.description: The display name of the identity.For drive items, the display name might not always be available or up to date. For example, if a user changes their display name the API might show the new value in a future response, but the items associated with the user don't show up as changed when using delta.

id.description: Unique identifier for the identity or actor. For example, in the access reviews decisions API, this property might record the id of the principal, that is, the group, user, or application that's subject to review.

upgradeAvailable.description: Indicates whether there are higher storage quota plans available. Read-only.

coverImageItemId.description: Unique identifier of the driveItem that is the cover of the album.

crc32Hash.description: The CRC32 value of the file (if available). Read-only.

quickXorHash.description: A proprietary hash of the file that can be used to determine if the contents of the file change (if available). Read-only.

sha1Hash.description: SHA1 hash for the contents of the file (if available). Read-only.

sha256Hash.description: This property isn't supported. Don't use.

sortBy.description: The method by which the folder should be sorted.

sortOrder.description: If true, indicates that items should be sorted in descending order. Otherwise, items should be sorted ascending.

viewType.description: The type of view that should be used to represent the folder.

queuedDateTime.description: Date and time the pending binary operation was queued in UTC time. Read-only.

request-id.description: Request Id as tracked internally by the service

client-request-id.description: Client request Id as sent by the client application.

top.name: $top
top.description: Show only the first n items
